text:
Which statement about bromine is correct?
A
Bromine has a greater density than chlorine.
B
Bromine is a gas at room temperature and pressure.
C
Bromine has a grey-black colour.
D
Bromine is less reactive than iodine.

options.label: A
options.text: Bromine has a greater density than chlorine.

options.label: B
options.text: Bromine is a gas at room temperature and pressure.

options.label: D
options.text: Bromine is less reactive than iodine.

subject: Chemistry
